subject: Degenerative calcific aortic stenosis
object: an active process. Disruption and dysfunction of the valve endothelium, lipid accumulation and infiltration by lymphocytes and macrophages occur. These cells release pro-inflammatory molecules that recruit fibroblasts and activate osteoblasts, leading to fibrosis and progressive thickening that develops into severe calcification over time. Calcification restricts leaflet movement, reduces valve area and obstructs flow.
source: Article: Manzo R, Ilardi F, Nappa D et al. Echocardiographic Evaluation of Aortic Stenosis: A Comprehensive Review. Diagnostics 2023
source_quote: Degenerative calcific AS is an active process characterized by the disruption of the aortic valvular endothelium with endothelial dysfunction, lipid accumulation, and infiltration of lymphocytes and macrophages that release pro-inflammatory molecules; they recruit fibroblasts and activate osteoblasts, leading to valve fibrosis, progressive thickening, that, over time, evolves into severe valve calcification . Therefore, valve calcification leads to restriction of leaflets mobility, valve area reduction, and flow obstruction.

subject: Severe aortic stenosis
object: chronic pressure overload that increases left ventricular wall stress and causes cardiomyocyte hypertrophy. This compensates early on but increases myocardial oxygen demand without a matching increase in coronary capillaries. This progressively leads to myocyte degeneration, death and fibrosis. Left ventricular contractile function declines when wall stress exceeds the compensating mechanism.
source: Article: Manzo R, Ilardi F, Nappa D et al. Echocardiographic Evaluation of Aortic Stenosis: A Comprehensive Review. Diagnostics 2023
source_quote: Severe AS is associated with chronic pressure overload that causes an increase in LV wall stress and leads to a hypertrophic response of the cardiomyocytes. Although effective in an early stage, this compensatory effect increases myocardial oxygen demand, in the absence of a balanced increase in the coronary capillary network. This will progressively lead to myocyte degeneration, death, and fibrosis . When wall stress exceeds the compensating mechanism, LV contractile function declines .

subject: Dobutamine stress echocardiography
object: in low-flow, low-gradient aortic stenosis, while its role in the paradoxical form is still being studied. In the paradoxical form, systolic flow across the valve is below normal despite preserved left ventricular ejection fraction, so detecting true severe stenosis is crucial. Ventricular hypertrophy is common and, together with preserved ejection fraction, could invalidate the test. Clavel and colleagues nevertheless demonstrated that it distinguished different forms of stenosis even in paradoxical low-flow, low-gradient disease.
source: Article: Manzo R, Ilardi F, Nappa D et al. Echocardiographic Evaluation of Aortic Stenosis: A Comprehensive Review. Diagnostics 2023
source_quote: While DSE plays a key role in LFLG AS, its role in paradoxical LFLG AS is under investigation. Despite the preserved LVEF, transvalvular flow throughout systole is below normal, thus it is crucial to detect true severe AS. PLFLG often affects patients with hypertrophied ventricles, a condition that, together with preserved EF, could invalidate the use of DSE. On the contrary, Clavel et al. proved the accuracy of DSE in distinguishing between different forms of AS, even in PLFLG .
